teams.emptyDesc: A team is a persistent squad spec — a lead plus members bound to agents. Assigning work to a team spawns a fresh session group from the spec; the spec survives the group.
teams.deleteDesc: Delete "{name}"? Runs already spawned from it are unaffected.
teams.aiBriefPh: Describe the team — e.g. "a squad for auth work: tech lead, 2 devs, a reviewer"…
teams.aiHint: AI fills the form below — you review before saving.
teams.aiFailed: Could not draft the team — try rephrasing.
teams.page.title: Teams
teams.page.tagline: Persistent squads — a lead + members you can run on any project.
teams.create.title: New team
teams.create.blankDesc: Pick the lead and members yourself.
teams.create.aiDesc: Describe the squad — AI drafts the spec.
teams.detail.leadHint: Receives squad work and routes it.
teams.detail.instructionsHint: Squad-wide routing rules — delivered to the lead only, on each run.
teams.detail.instructionsPh: e.g. "Backend work → Dev — Auth; every diff goes through Reviewer before in_review."
teams.detail.noRuns: No live runs — press Run to materialize this team.
teams.runFailed: Could not start the team run
teams.sort.name: Name
teams.autoCreateAgentsHint: Members/lead with no agent get a new AGENT.md in the team's tier, bound on save.
